(1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros dum sgrigs ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros dum sgrigs ma bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis phyed 'byongs pa zhig shi na/ srid par mngal du zhugs dbang yod/ mi zhugs na'ang dbang yod de/ de nyid du sangs rgya'o// bskyed rim phyed tsam 'byongs pa zhig shi na/ bar dor rigs gang 'dod kyi mngal du 'jug ste/ gdams ngag dran nas skye ba de nyid la sangs rgya'o// de ni skye ba gcig gis sangs rgyas zhes bya'o// rigs mthun mngal gyi bar do zhes kyang bya'o// des na/ bar do lnga ru yang 'gro ste/ de ni gnyug ma'i lam mo// blo chos nyid kyi bar do ste/ skye shi gnyis kyi bar do dang*/ rmi lam bar do dang*/ srid pa bar do'o// de la gsum ste/ rnam par smin pa'i lus dang*/ yid kyi lus dang*/ bag chags kyi lus so// de la bsre ba gsum ste/ skye 'chi 'dod chags dang bsre/ rmi lam gti mug dang bsre/ srid pa zhe sdang dang bsre'o// de la bar do chung ngu gsum ste/ gnyid nyal mtshams su 'od gsal skye ba'i dus dang gcig /gnyid (2na)sad nas bar dor rtogs pa skye ba'i dus dang gnyis/ bzang dbugs chad ma chad bar der rtog med skye ba'i dus dang gsum du bstan pa yin no// skye shi'i mngon du 'od gsal byed/ mtshams sbyor ni dbang gsum pa'o// gnyid kyi mngon du rmi lam byed/ mtshams ni tshar gcod sbyor ba'o// srid pa'i mngon du 'od gsal byed/ mtshams ni slob dpon yab yum gyi chags pa la/ zhe sdang mig ser med pa'o// de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i shes pa 'dzin pa med pa/ rang gi phyag rgya la mig ser med pa'o// srid pa bar dor pha ma'i 'du shes mi skye bas mngal du mi 'jug pa'o// na mo gu ru/ da ni gnas lugs kyi sgom pa ston pa ste/ dbang po rab lta thog tu skyel ba dang*/ 'bring sgom thog tu bzhag pa'o// sgom pa la gnyis/ lta thog nas sgom tshol ba dang*/ sgom thog nas lta ba tshol ba'o// da ni 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/

sems nyid gsal ba 'dzin med kyi shes pa/ rtog med du tsan ne gzhog /(2ba)gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' sel/ 'dzin pa med pas rtag pa'i mtha' sel/ bde na bde rgyu med de/ bzang po snyam pa'i nga rgyal med/ ngan no snyam pa'i 'jigs pa'i skyon gyis ma gos/ sems nyid rnam rtog gi lhad ma zhugs/ rig pa rang rtog med du tsan ne zhog /de ltar bzhag pa'i dus su/ rtog med kyi ye shes/ phyogs med rang grol du 'char gyis/ de sgom pa'i skyobs shes kyang bya/ rgyab rten zhes kyang bya/ 'dir rkang grangs bco lngas bstan te/ dang po kho rig pa stong par gyur pas/ 'gyu ba rang sangs kyi gdams ngag bstan pa dang gcig /rnam rtog la skyar zhon bstan pa dang gnyis/ bde ba ngos bzung med pa dang gsum/ wal po rjes med dang bzhi/ dran pa rang yal dang lnga/ gsal la rtog pa med pa dang drug /snang ba 'dzin pa med pa dang bdun/ khyab pa zhen pa med pa dang brgyad/ nam mkha'i bya bzhin rig pa rten med dang dgu /nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin sems nyid 'phro 'du med pa'i ngang la bzhag pa dang bcu/ chu bo rgyun 'bab bzhin du/ sems nyid rgyun chad med pa'i ngang la bzhag pa dang bcu gcig /gsal cha ma 'gags la/ 'dzin pa mi mnga' bar bzhag pa dang bcu gnyis/ snang la rtog pa med pa 'dzin cha lhug pa dang bcu gsum/ ris med du snang zhing zhen med du shar ba dang bcu bzhi// sgom med rgyud la thebs nas/ 'dzin med rang sar grol bar bstan pa dang bco lnga'o// gnas lugs sgom pa'i man ngag go/ ༈ //na mo gu ru/ snang ba 'di sgyu mar mthong bas sgyu lus/ sgyu ma de stong par shes na 'od gsal/ de gnyis tha mi dad pas na zung 'jug go /kun rdzob tu yang stong na 'chal ba'i shes rab/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad sogs (3na)la// de la sdig pa 'byung mi 'gyur// sgyu ma'i sems dang ldan pa la// dag dang sdom sems 'byung bar 'gyur// 'di spyod 'jug shes rab le'u nas bshad do//

༈ na mo gu ru/ yul dang mi chos zug rngu skyed par byed pa'i nad dang 'dra bas rgyab tu bor// zas nor mi rtag nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra bas de la yid ma chags// tshe srog mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra bas brtson 'grus bskyed// bla ma bshes gnyen yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra bas gus pas gsol ba thob// gdams ngag zab mo gsol bar byed pa'i kha zas 'dra bas rtag tu nyams su long*// dal 'byor rnyed dka' u dum wa ra'i me tog 'dra bas don med spyod pas chud ma gsan// sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba ni dngos por 'dzin pa yin pas/ stong nyid kyi sems dang ma bral/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa mi slu bas/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du ma bsad/ 'bras bu zad mi shes pa ljon shing dang 'dra bas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rtag tu sgoms/ 'dod pa dug gi lo ma dang 'dra bas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la gyis/ na mo gu ru/ 'od gsal gyi ngo bo ni/ dag cing gsal bar 'dug pas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ cir mthong*/ cir snang thams cad ye shes su 'char bas na/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so// thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas na/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so// de lta bu'i ngo bo la gzhan don 'byung bas na bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so// thams cad skye med stong par shes pas na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o skol sgom chen pa rnams/ rgyud la yon tan ci 'dug blta dgos pa yin/ 'chi ba sgom pa'i dus na/ tshe 'di las blo log gam ma log /(3ba)mi rtag pa bsgoms pas 'khor ba la blo log gam ma log /las 'bras bsgom pas/ nyes pa las blo log gam ma log /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ sems can la blo 'gro'am mi 'gro /ci chod na 'dug blta dgos pa yin/ rgyud la yon tan med par/ sog me bzang byas pas mi 'ong gsung*/

chos thams cad bden pa gnyis rten 'brel skor cig tu byas nas khyer dgos pa yin/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems man chad yin/ de yang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur tshogs gnyis gsog dgos pa yin no// don dam bden pa sgro skur gnyis dang bral ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na ye shes yod byas na/ sgro btags par 'gro /med byas na skur 'debs su 'gro bas na/ don dam pa ni spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ rtsis gdab mi btang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ rtsol sgrub drag po byas nas bsgoms na 'ong ba yin/ kun rdzob gtan la phebs na/ don dam gdod 'ong ba yin/ yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// de la kun rdzob bden pa dang*// don dam pa yi bden pa gnyis// kun rdzob la/ yang dag pa dang*/ log pa gnyis/ yang dag pa/ las 'bras la yid ches pa'o// log pa chu nang gi zla ba la sogs pa'o// grub pa'i mtha' log pa'i bden par 'dzin pa a 'thas kyi shes pa'o// yang dag pa'i kun rdzob/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// zhes (4na)gsungs so// de la dpe gsum ste/ sgyu ma mkhan yang dag pa'i kun rdzob/ sgyu ma la bred pa'i mi log pa'i kun rdzob/ sgyu ma'i sngags kyis ma thebs pa ri gsum gyi mi ci yang ma mthong ba don dam pa'o// snum khur dang*/ dbyug pa'i dpe gsung*/ mi gcig la snum khur gcig dang*/ dbyug pa cig dang gnyis bcol ba la/ len phyin pas/ dbyug pa byi bas zos zer nas/ dbyug pa zos na/ snum khur la lta ci smos zer lo// de bzhin du/ kun rdzob la rang bzhin med na/ don dam pa lta ci smos gsung*/ rdo rje gdan gyi dpe yang gsung*/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba la/

rmi lam ltar 'khrul pa yin gsung ngo*/// /na mo gu ru/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la/ sdom pa gsum rten 'brel skor cig tu gnas dgos te/ gnas na ji ltar gnas/ bsrung na ji ltar bsrung*/ ldan na ji ltar ldan/ 'chos na ji ltar 'chos/ gnas pa bye brag tu gnas te/ mkhan slob la sdom pa blangs pa'i dus su/ so thar gyi sdom pa thob snyam/ sems bskyed pa'i dus su/ sems bskyed/ byang chub sems dpa' yin snyam/ gsang sngags kyi dus su/ ngas dbang thob theg chen gsang sngags pa yin snyam/ bsrung ba/ so thar 'dul ba bzhin bsrung*/ sde snod kyi ma mo bzhin du bsrung*/ rtsa ltung rtsa 'grel bzhin bsrung*/ ldan na yar ldan te/ thug 'dom byung dus/ rim gyi gong ma gnyis gtso bor bya'o// 'chos na/ grub mthas 'chos te so thar la skyon byung na 'dul ba bzhin 'chos/ sems bskyed la sde snod bzhin/ dam tshig la rtsa ltung bzhin 'chos/ de ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'o// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ni/ sdom pa (4ba)rnams la bsngo bgrang byed cing*/ rang gi sems glang chen smyon pa dang 'dra ba de/ tshul khrims kyi dmigs pa'i ka ba la/ dran pa'i zhags pas dam du bcing*/ shes rab kyi lcags kyus gzung nas/ blo rim gyis sgom pa ni zhi gnas so// de ltar zhi gnas la rtse gcig tu bzhag nas/ lhag mthong gis dpyad gzhigs 'gyed de/ sdom pa la rtog dpyod btang bas/ ji srid rtog dpyod 'dug phan chad bsam shes la/ rtog dpyod las 'das phan chad sgom ma nges na/ sgom mi shes so zer ba 'dug / shes so// shes rab kyis chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs pa de lhag pa shes rab yin gsungs so/// /na mo gu ru/ bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ theg pa chen po'i snod du bshad pa lags/ phyag rgya chen po la gnyis te/ phyi gzung ba'i yul rten 'brel tshogs pa'i ngor snang*/ sna tshogs su snang ba 'di shes pa'i 'khrul snang yin te/

re zhig rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu/ gzugs brnyan lta bu/ ming tsam/ brda' tsam/ btags pa tsam las/ dngos po'i ngo bo nyid du ma grub pa cig yin/ 'on kyang*/ las rgyu 'bras ni rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du ye mi slu bar shes dgos/ de rnams ni de ltar rtogs pa go bar bya ba'i chos so// nyams su blang ba la/ rang rig 'od gsal ba 'di rang bzhin chos sku/ skye med thams cad la khyab pa 'di'i ngo bo rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa'i sing nge ye re ba 'di lags/ de'i ngang la rnam rtog sna tshogs su byung ba 'di/ bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan tsam yin/ ngo bo goms pa las tha ma 'od gsal du shar ba lags so// de ltar sems 'od gsal de ma bcos par bzhag /rang dgar bzhag /rang gsal ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bzhag /de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ shes pa gsal la mi rtog pa/ bde la dang ba'i nyams 'char te/ des rang rgyud tshims nas shin tu yid ches pa 'byung ngo*// de ni nyams su myong ba yin no// rang gi sems kyi ngo bo skye 'jig med pa/ dus (5na)thams cad pa/ mi 'gyur ba/ lhun gyis grub pa de ltar go na/ rtogs pa rang gi sems nyid de/ chos sku phyag rgya chen po yin nges snyam pa cig dgos gsung ngo*/// /na mo gu ru/ gcig por sdod pa la gdeng rnam pa bzhi dgos te/ lta ba'i gdeng bya ba chos thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su rtogs pas/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid du go ba cig dgos/ nyams myong gi gdeng bya ba/ rang la don gyi ngo bo shar bas/ blo'i yul du ci dang ci byung ba thams cad/ de'i ngang du shes pa cig dgos/ gsang sngags nus pa'i gdeng bya ba/ rang gi yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa thim pas/ yi dwags la sogs pa'i gnod pa ci byung yang*/ phaṭa byas pas chog snyam pa zhig dgos/ bla ma'i man ngag gi gdeng bya ba/ zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa'i/ las gang dang gang yin pa shes pa cig dgos/ zhes gsungs so/// /na mo gu ru/

lar sgrub pa po rtag tu sgom pa la/ chos 'di rnams dgos pa yin/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rtag tu sgom dgos/ de theg chen gyi gzhi rtsa yin/ rang lus lha sku sgyu ma tsam du sgom dgos/ de gnyis kyis sangs rgyas nas gzugs sku gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyu yin/ thabs lam gyi rdzogs rim nus tshad sgom dgos/ de zung 'jug gi rtogs pa sgrub pa dang*/ 'byung ba'i nad kyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ ḍā ki chos skyong rang bzhin gyis 'du ba yin/ tsha gro'i rjes la gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa tshan re tsam byed pa yin/ de phrin las 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu yin no// de ltar bskyal bas phyis gang la yang thogs rdugs med pa cig 'ong ba yin/ dus rtag tu sems la ma yengs par blta ba yin/ de 'dus ma byas (5ba)yin/ 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa thabs khyad par can rnams kyang de'i ngang las ma yengs par byed pa zung 'jug gi rtogs pa sgrub pa yin/ spyir chos gsha' mar byed pa'i gang zag la/ chos skyong dang ḍā kis rang bzhin gyis srung ba rten 'brel gyi che ba yin/ de yang*/ yi dam gyi gtor ma'i rjes la mkha' 'gro chos skyong la bsngos nas/ bdag gi bar chad zhi bar mdzod cig ces 'phrin las bcol ba yin/ las kyi khro bo re la bsnyen pa bag tsam re bskyal nas/ nam dgos pa dang las la sbyor ba yin/ sbyor kha chen po byas pas chog pa yin/ lha gang la btags kyang 'ong*/ spyir rang ngam gzhan la bar chad byung na/ yi dwags la las sbyor byas pas/ rang la sdig pa mi 'ong*/ 'dre de rang gi rnam rtog yin/ rnam rtog med pa la sdig pa med de/ yul logs nas grub pa med/ de bas 'phrin las/ sangs rgyas kyis rnam rtog med par gsungs pa yin pas/ las sbyor byas pa la sdig pa mi 'ong ba yin pas/ ling ga la sogs pa la rang gi rnam rtog bkug nas las sbyor bya gsung ngo*// de tsho yang gal che ste/ spyir nang du chos cig chod nas des nga ci ltar byas kyang btub snyam pa cig 'ong ba yin gsung ngo*/// /na mo gu ru/

theg chen gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na/ chos thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu 'dus pa yin/ theg pa 'og ma dang bstun na/ mi dge ba bcu spong ba dang*/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa yin te/ de yang lus kyi gsum po spong ba sku'i dam tshig /ngag gi bzhi spong ba gsung gi dam tshig /yid kyi gsum spong ba thugs kyi'o// de'i steng du theg pa chen po bas/ sems can thams cad pha mar byas nas/ (6na)lus kyi phan 'dogs pa sku'i dam tshig /ngag gis 'dogs pa gsung gi dam tshig /yid kyis 'dogs pa thugs kyi'o// de'i steng du/ gsang sngags pas/ thams cad yi dam lhar byas nas/ mchod pa byed pa yin te/ bdag gzhan thams cad lha sku sgyu ma lta bur sgom pa sku'i dam tshig /ngag sngags kyi bzlas pa byed pa gsung gi dam tshig /sems 'od gsal skye med sgom pa thugs kyi'o// de ltar thabs shes rab tu shes pas/ chos thams cad thabs shes su sgom pa 'di man ngag tu che ba yin/ des na/ rang rgyud la chos 'di'i nang nas 'byung ba ltar/ spang bya rnams spangs sam ma spangs/ nyams su blang bya rnams blangs sam ma blangs snyam du blta ba gal che'o/ zhes gsungs so/// /na mo gu ru/ rgyal po gzhon nu'i spyod pa ni/ 'jig rten pas gshe yis dogs pas rgyal po'i spyod tshul las mi nyams par byed do// de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa yang bskyed rdzogs kyi dam tshig las mi 'da' bar byed cing sgrub bo// gsang sngags pa ni rang gi yul dang*/ ming rus dang*/ chos bla ma thams cad gsang nas grong khyer du ltos/ sngar gyi dang khyad par 'dug gam blta/ khyad par 'dug na da rung dben pa bsten la/ de la brtan pa thob nas/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la 'jug ste/ spyod pa'i dus tshod ni/ gzhan mi mos pa sgyur nus pa yin te/ tai lo nā ro dang*/ slob dpon dril bu pa lta bu'o// de mthar phyin nas mnyam bzhag chen po'i spyod pa la 'jug pa yin te/

chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas zas phyogs med/ gos phyogs med/ spyod pa phyogs med/ phyogs thams cad dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa (6ba)yin te/ mthar phyin pa'o/// /na mo gu ru/ phyag rgya chen po la dus gsum yod de/ lhun gyis grub pa'i dus ni/ sems kyi ngo bo de la brten zhing*/ dbang thob pa snyam byed tsa na/ sangs rgyas kyi rten skyes pa yin te/ lhun gyis grub pa'o// bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dus ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du rtogs pa la bya ste/ bden pa mthong ba'o// bde ba chen po'i dus ni/ las dang*/ srid pa'i sa bon rnam shes 'gags nas/ chos sku phyag rgya chen po mngon du byas pa'o/// /na mo gu ru/ don dam pa la rgyu 'bras rtsi rgyu med/ kun rdzob la rtsi ba yin/ rgyu yang dag pa'i kun rdzob rnal ma zhig la/ 'bras bu gzugs sku gnyis 'byung*/ rgyu log pa'i kun rdzob la/ 'bras bu 'khor ba'i bde sdug 'byung*/ sa dang po'i byang chub sems dpa' yan chad la/ zag pa med pa'i sdom pa bya ba yod de/ mthong lam gyi mnyam bzhag de yin/ de'i rjes kyi shes pa chos thams cad sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang khyad med par mkhyen pa/ de rnams kyi mngon sum yin/ da lta so so skye bo'i rgyud la ngo bo rnal mar skyes pa'i don de/ zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims yin/ de'i rjes kyi shes pa/ phyi'i yul la blo gtad na sgyu mar 'char/ stong par 'gro ba de/ rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum yin/ rgyu 'bras 'di man chad la rtsi ba yin gsung ngo*/// /na mo gu ru/ chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba'o// chos ni/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'o// chos su 'gro ba ni/ dge ba byed pa thams cad tshe 'di'i 'du shes kyis ma bslad pa'o// lam du 'gro ba ni (7na)dge ba ci byed thams cad/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis 'phangs nas/

gzhan don du bsngo ba'o// lam 'khrul pa sel ba ni/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems de nyid la goms pas/ chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa shar nas/ dngos por 'dzin pa las log pa'o// 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba ni/ rtog pa de bsgom pa la brten nas/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo gnyug ma'i don rtogs shing*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing*/ skye ba med par rtogs pa'o// zhes gsung ngo*/// /na mo gu ru/ rgyu sdug bsngal las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba yod/ rgyu sdug bsngal las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba yod/ rgyu bde ba las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba yod/ rgyu bde ba las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba yod/ de la dang po ni/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa la blo shor nas sdig pa mi 'dzem/ sdug pa la mi blta/ gtam ngan pa la mi blta bar/ dus rtag tu 'dod pas gdungs pa ni/ rgyu sdug bsngal yin la/ 'bras bu ngan song du skye'o// gnyis pa rgyu sdug bsngal las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba ni/ mkhan slob kyi spyan sngar so thar gyi sdom pa tshul bzhin blangs nas/ dka' thub dang*/ dka' spyad byed pa ni rgyu sdug bsngal ltar 'dug ste/ 'bras bu lha mi'i bde ba thob bo// gsum pa rgyu bde ba las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni/ tshe snga ma sbyin pa btang ba'i shugs kyis 'dod yon la longs spyod rgyu byung nas/ chos mi byed par de'i ro la blta zhing chags pa ni/ rgyu bde ba ltar 'dug ste/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa rgyu bde ba las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba ni/ bla ma rtogs ldan (7ba)cig gis/ slob ma snod ldan cig khrid nas/ ri la sgom pa ni/ rgyu bde/ lam bde/ 'bras bu bde bas na/ bde ba chen po zhes bya'o/// /spyir bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos lha rje nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs// mi nga rang gang yin zer tsa na// nga rang tshul khrims snying po yin// mi la la ni gtso bo gtso bo zer// gtso bo zer yang 'gyod rgyu med// gros su shākya mu ne bzhugs// la la ni gnas brtan gnas brtan zer// gnas brtan zer yang 'gyod rgyu med// gnas gzhir lha sa rnam gnyis bzhugs// mtho la mtho 'grogs ma byas shing*// dma' la khyad du gsod ma myong*// mnyam la 'gran sems ma byas te// grogs shed mthun byung na thad sor skyong*// nor yod na bla ma rje la mchod// med na shes pa glod la gzhag
/pha 'jig rten grags pa de skad gsung*/// /
